What this means for your business

A clipboard can be faster than a login. It becomes a problem when several people need the same current information or mistakes create customer and cash problems.

What to watch

  • The same fact copied into a calendar, spreadsheet, email, and invoice.
  • Staff waiting for one notebook or one person’s memory.
  • Double bookings, lost requests, or inconsistent totals.
  • A weekly report rebuilt from scratch.

Do this next

  1. Pick one repeated task.
  2. Count minutes, repeats, corrections, and people for one week.
  3. Multiply by the hourly cost you choose, including the real cost of that person’s work.
  4. Fix the worst handoff with the smallest reliable tool.

When Little Fight fits

We can build the measurement and connect or replace the day-to-day steps. We will label the result as an estimate, show the formula, and leave paper alone where paper wins.

Get a plain-English second opinion

insight.answer: Measure the repeated searching, retyping, reconciling, and correcting with your own time and pay before calling paper a loss. Paper is not the enemy; the repeat work is the cost.
